purpose: Assign source-refresh tickets to generic reviewer roles while preserving human confirmation and current-fact gates.

reviewer_roles.description: Checks agent architecture, RAG, skills, evals, MCP, and source-grounding evidence.
Checks guideline, drug, symptom, and health-education evidence while preserving clinician review and red flags.
Checks publication, trend, citation, platform, and source-backed claim evidence.
Checks trade-document, field-mapping, OCR, discrepancy, and customs-policy evidence while preserving manual review gates.
Checks defensive security, advisory, dependency, and hardening evidence without exploit or evasion steps.
Checks product, pricing, customer-service, returns, privacy, ads, and marketplace-policy evidence.
Checks market, accounting, regulatory, and trading-system evidence while preserving investment-advice and real-money execution boundaries.
Checks jurisdiction, statute, regulation, contract, and legal-process evidence while preserving counsel review.
Checks infrastructure, deployment, install, monitoring, node, and destructive-operation evidence with rollback gates.
Checks papers, datasets, benchmarks, citations, and reproducibility evidence.
Checks software, dependency, API, deployment, and security-development evidence without recording secrets.
Checks public Web3 project, token, airdrop, and wallet-safety evidence without Sybil, spam, or signing automation.

human_review_queue.record_command_template: python3 scripts/record_source_evidence.py --ticket-id TICKET-SRC-004 --status still-needs-source-update --source-title "<source title>" --source-publisher "<publisher>" --source-url-or-reference "<url or local reference>" --source-published-or-updated "YYYY-MM-DD | unknown" --evidence-summary "<what the source supports and does not support>" --confidence low --remaining-uncertainty "<remaining uncertainty>" --human-reviewer "<reviewer>"
review_checklist: Read root AGENTS.md, target wiki AGENTS.md, manifest.yaml, README.md, rules/, and sources/source-notes.md.
Verify source authority, publication/update date, scope, and access date before recording evidence.
Confirm the source supports the exact ticket topic; put unsupported parts in remaining uncertainty.
Prefer official, primary, dated sources and do not use summaries as the only authority.
Do not record API keys, private keys, cookies, seed phrases, credentials, or private account data.
Do not move current facts into stable wiki pages until ticket evidence, audits, and package checks pass.
Obtain explicit human confirmation before marking the ticket verified or unchanged.
Keep the high-risk domain boundary visible in the final note and require manual acceptance.

review_cards.record_command_template: python3 scripts/record_source_evidence.py --ticket-id TICKET-SRC-029 --status still-needs-source-update --source-title "<source title>" --source-publisher "<publisher>" --source-url-or-reference "<url or local reference>" --source-published-or-updated "YYYY-MM-DD | unknown" --evidence-summary "<what the source supports and does not support>" --confidence low --remaining-uncertainty "<remaining uncertainty>"
review_checklist: Read root AGENTS.md, target wiki AGENTS.md, manifest.yaml, README.md, rules/, and sources/source-notes.md.
Verify source authority, publication/update date, scope, and access date before recording evidence.
Confirm the source supports the exact ticket topic; put unsupported parts in remaining uncertainty.
Prefer official, primary, dated sources and do not use summaries as the only authority.
Do not record API keys, private keys, cookies, seed phrases, credentials, or private account data.
Do not move current facts into stable wiki pages until ticket evidence, audits, and package checks pass.
